events.source: Read from the issuer FY2025 earnings release income statement of 2 March 2026 (EGP, stored absolute). Income Tax is the printed Current Income Taxes 256,985,432 less the printed Deferred income taxes benefit of 131,625,556. No EPS row: the release prints none.
